verdict.rationale: PayPal documents registrable webhooks (HTTPS posts to a subscribed URL per event type) and REST APIs. Subscriptions advertise 'automate payment recovery for failed payments.' Agents get tools for subscriptions and invoices, including `send_invoice_reminder`, and invoices support automatic payment reminders, so the building blocks for agent-driven dunning are first-party. However, nothing ties these into an agent-controlled failed-payment loop: recovery appears to be PayPal-automated rather than agent-triggered, and no failed-payment event types are shown. Missing for 10: documented failed-payment webhook event types, an API or agent tool to trigger or configure payment retries, dunning outreach tied specifically to failed subscription payments, and hands-on corroboration.
